Game Overview

At its heart, Fluttering Bats is a casual game about guide three nimble bats through mesmerizing landscapes, avoiding perilous obstacles with strategic taps. Hone your reflexes and timing to keep your trio airborne in ever-evolving challenges. Experience this unique twist on an iconic classic where maintaining balance is key to mastering the fluttering adventure. Ready your skills for this captivating journey!
